gaps.legacy: nirs4all archives replay fitted host models, including independent by-source outputs from no-split full training
gaps.dagml: Public nirs4all by-source CV and no-split training now capture signed DAG-ML packages and replay named outputs from archives on PyO3 and CLI; C/WASM/PyO3 also expose portable Raw package operations. A one-shot CLI process adapter cannot export a Raw payload after its worker exits, and the persistent adapter frame protocol has no export/hydrate/release messages. Cross-language CLI Raw operator replay therefore needs a protocol extension and a concrete portable operator serializer

gaps.legacy: ResidualModel composes base model, residual learner, gate and fusion within CV, including an automatic gate, finetune_space and nested operator choices; branch(models) -> merge(predictions) -> ResidualModel also executes
gaps.dagml: the native graph supports fixed/automatic gates, preprocessing, learner search, training-only internal OOF for unsplit train/test, nested `_or_` base/learner campaigns, prediction-feature joins, and PyTorch learner train_params with PyO3/CLI CV, REFIT and archive replay; arbitrary chains of two marked nested meta models remain rejected by the singleton planner, while TensorFlow/JAX residual learner train_params remain unverified
gaps.evidence: test_controller_inventory.py covers fixed/auto-gate, finetune, unsplit holdout and 2x2 nested choices; test_residual_prediction_feature_join.py covers prediction-feature composition with fixed/auto gates and explicit/implicit CV in PyO3 and CLI; test_residual_target_preprocessing.py verifies PyTorch learner train_params, refit and archive replay on both mechanisms; dag-ml runtime ignored test nested_stacking_then_residual_accepts_dependent_meta_models records the remaining multi-meta planner boundary; test_residual_legacy_limits.py records classification and multi-target failures in legacy, while legacy splitter+augmentation+ResidualModel fails with a target-length mismatch

gaps.dagml: the native nested OOF campaign currently accepts only one declared meta node per execution plan; the Python pipeline reports unsupported_shape for the second level. The fix belongs in DAG-ML's recursive campaign planner and must preserve fold-local OOF evidence at each level
